lines.zh: 我拖着腿，一步一步挪过去。
lines.en: I drag my leg and shuffle forward.
The soles of my shoes are worn through.
I go slow, and never rest.

lines.zh: 我甩着胳膊，肩膀一歪一歪。
lines.en: My arms swing and my shoulders lurch.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩过碎玻璃，没有感觉。
lines.en: I step on broken glass and feel nothing.
I pass a wrecked car.

lines.zh: 我绕过路障，往你那头走。
lines.en: I round the barricade and head your way.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里一直有声音。
lines.en: There's a sound in my throat.
I walk on the shadows, closer and closer.

lines.zh: 我的双腿僵得不太会弯。
lines.en: My legs are too stiff to bend well.
I walk with my head cocked.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下黑脚印。
lines.en: Dark footprints stay where I pass.
I stand with my head hanging.
My breathing is coarse.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有活的东西。
lines.en: I listen for anything alive.
My jaw won't close.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地抬起头，又垂下去。
lines.en: I raise my head slowly, then let it drop.
Dried blood at the corner of my mouth.
I stand in the shade and don't move.
My stomach growls.
I claw at my own neck.
I wait for the sun to go down.
You're still up. That's good.
My neck bones sit at an angle.
Your blood is moving. I can smell it.
I lick my teeth slowly.
These legs of mine gave out from running.
You're still warm.
I lift half a face from the ground.
Your shadow stretches to my feet.
I know what the living look like.
I reach a hand toward you.
I step back and sway.
My shoulder is knocked crooked.
I make a coarse sound.
A patch of skin came off. I feel nothing.
Leg broken — I'll crawl if I must.
I turn my head back slowly.
My leg is stiffer now.
Black blood runs from my mouth.
Your blows fall heavier than I thought.
I have not gone down yet.
That warmth is alive.
The smell on you is strong.
I turn toward it slowly.
My mouth hangs open, not biting.
I approach a step at a time.
This makes me hungry.
My fingers close on nothing.
Two steps more and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我忘了自己为什么停下。
lines.en: I forget why I stopped.
Blood smell, drifting from your sleeve.
You hit me and I nearly come apart.
I lurch sideways and catch myself.

lines.zh: 我的手指勾到你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers catch your sleeve.
Don't push; my legs are stiff.
We collide and I give half a step.
Knocked crooked, I just lean back upright.
I press to you and sniff.
That took some skin off me.
I lurch around you.
My weight pushed you off balance.
Another shuffles up, dragging a leg too.
We sniff each other.

lines.zh: 它的脸烂得比我的厉害。
lines.en: Its face is worse gone than mine.
We stand side by side, heads cocked.

lines.zh: 它咬了一下我的肩，没用力。
lines.en: It bites my shoulder without force.
Our breathing is equally coarse.
It walks; I follow.
We shuffle the same way.
Two shadows line up on the wall.
There are two of us here now.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，只能跪下去。
lines.en: I can't bend, so I kneel.
I grab something up.
Two bites and it won't give.
I chew it bones and all.
I stand holding it a long while.
I forget I'm holding it.
Too slippery. It fell.
I pick it up again.
I drag it along.
It weighs my hand down.
You moved just now.
I turn my head.
My breathing quickens.
I raise both hands slowly.
Seeing you, I stop being hungry.

lines.zh: 我一步迈出去，腿差点软。
lines.en: I step out and my leg nearly gives.
I can reach at this distance.
My upper and lower teeth part wide.
I've noted which way you ran.
Don't expect me to stop.
I lurch toward you.
This is how the living smell.
My fingers begin to claw.
I shuffle one step closer.
This time I'll get my teeth in.
I follow, one step at a time.
You speed up; so do I, a little.
I keep my head cocked at you.
My shoes scrape on the ground.
I don't go around. I come straight.
Your prints are clear.
I'm behind you. Not far.
You've stopped at a corner.
I limp closer.
My fingers keep working.
You pant, and I hear it.
There's no other way out.
Ten more steps and I'm there.
I'm not hurried, and I don't tire.
Your back is to me. Good.
My shadow reaches you first.

lines.zh: 你听见拖地的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the dragging?
Two steps between us.
My teeth sink into your arm.
I grab your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可我不会松。
lines.en: It's not heavy, but I won't let go.
You throw me off; I lunge back.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划开你的袖子。
lines.en: My nails open your sleeve.
Blood is on my mouth.
My teeth close once more.
You retreat; I drag after you.
My mouth opens and shuts.
You struggle hard.
I hold on with my teeth.
My teeth are blunt, and I bite hard.
You've slowed at last.
I lift my head, blood dripping.
I can bite once more.
Do you hear yourself panting?

lines.zh: 街角有个人影，站得不对。
lines.en: A figure at the corner stands wrong.
I crawl out of the rubble.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在空街上传得很远。
lines.en: My steps carry down the empty street.

lines.zh: 这里多了一个活死的东西。
lines.en: Something undead has joined this place.

lines.zh: 我从倒下的招牌下钻出来。
lines.en: I come out from under a fallen sign.

lines.zh: 我的影子先出现在墙上。
lines.en: My shadow shows on the wall first.

lines.zh: 风里来了股腐烂的味道。
lines.en: A smell of rot comes on the wind.
I straighten up by degrees.
Drag marks join the road.
I stop in the middle of the street.

lines.zh: 我从土里坐起来，抖落泥。
lines.en: I sit up out of the dirt and shake it off.
I raise my head and look at the sky.
Is there anyone alive here?

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐地走出了巷子。
lines.en: I limp out of the alley.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的皮，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Fire sears my skin and I flinch.
I fall and my bones shift.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴，我咳不出来。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I can't cough.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻在废墟上。
lines.en: The blast throws me onto the rubble.
Something buries in my shoulder.
That spell heats my flesh.
I've been hungry too long.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I jerk.
The void pulls the ground from my feet.
